environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on EC2 in a private subnet. Traffic ingresses through an ALB in a public subnet. The VPC has an S3 Gateway Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with a custom endpoint policy that includes a Condition block restricting s3:GetObject to objects matching the prefix 'suggestions/' AND requiring that the object key matches the regex pattern '^suggestions/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.json$' via a StringLike condition on s3:prefix. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/search-acl/abc123) with a single custom rule group containing a regex pattern set that inspects QUERY_STRING for patterns matching '<[^>]*>' OR 'javascript:' OR event handler attributes, with action BLOCK and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the rule evaluates on every request. Additionally, the ALB injects a response header 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'' via a Lambda@Edge-equivalent ALB action (response header insertion via ALB fixed-response rule for the /search path that adds CSP headers through a listener rule with conditions).
